export HOPSWORKS_HOSTNAME_VERIFICATION=false
hops fg create recsfd473b --version 1 --primary-key rec_id --online \
  --features "rec_id:string:user_id#rank,user_id:string,rank:int,item_id:string" \
  --description "Top-5 recommendations per user (two-tower dot product, excluding seen items)" \
  --json 2>&1 | grep -E '"(name|version|id|online_enabled|onlineEnabled)"' | head

export HOPSWORKS_HOSTNAME_VERIFICATION=false
mkdir -p .tmp
hops sql --catalog delta --schema mlpabaf72f2_featurestore --json --limit 0 "
WITH scores AS (
  SELECT u.user_id AS user_id, i.item_id AS item_id,
    (u.e1*i.e1+u.e2*i.e2+u.e3*i.e3+u.e4*i.e4+u.e5*i.e5+u.e6*i.e6+u.e7*i.e7+u.e8*i.e8) AS score
  FROM user_emb_1 u CROSS JOIN item_emb_1 i
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM interactions_1 x WHERE x.user_id=u.user_id AND x.item_id=i.item_id)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, item_id,
    CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY score DESC, item_id ASC) AS INTEGER) AS rank
  FROM scores
)
SELECT user_id || '#' || CAST(rank AS VARCHAR) AS rec_id, user_id, rank, item_id
FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 5
ORDER BY user_id, rank
" 2>/dev/null > .tmp/recs_raw.json
wc -l .tmp/recs_raw.json; head -c 400 .tmp/recs_raw.json; echo; echo "..."; tail -c 200 .tmp/recs_raw.json
tool_input.description: Compute top-5 recs and capture JSON
